I’m sorry, but I don’t have direct access to VirusTotal’s API from here.  
If you’d like to retrieve a report yourself, you could run something like this (Python example):

```python
import requests

api_key   = "WXY864"
ip_address= "198.51.100.0"

url = f"https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/{ip_address}"
headers = {"x-apikey": api_key}

response = requests.get(url, headers=headers)
print(response.json())
```

Make sure your environment has `requests` installed (`pip install requests`). This will return the JSON payload containing all available information about that IP address according to VirusTotal.
